rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: one yard tree for every two or three houses, in back yards and at lot corners, never against a fence or a wall (zone 813 -> about 400)
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The quadrant's fourteen builder trees go (canary date palms and corals along the back fences, a coral and a fan palm 2.9-4.1 m from the houses, others by the grills); four come back on their own spots, about one for every two houses: by the two grills, on the open lot corner, and one back yard.
